subject: sessionctx: fix data race of SessionVars.Status (#50729)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff against its first parent in `executor`, `planner`, `session`, and `sessionctx`. The change replaces `SessionVars.Status` (exported `uint16`) with an internal atomic (`Uint32`) plus `Status()`/`HasStatusFlag()` accessors and CAS-based `SetStatusFlag`, and updates core call sites (cursor checks, session status reporting) and session-state migration (`SessionStates.Status` widened to `uint32`). No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, transaction/session, or concurrency regressions found in the touched paths. Checked later history up to `origin/master`; only one unrelated commit (issue template updates) exists and no follow-up fixes touch the modified runtime files.
